newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Presidents of China, South Korea have good talks.
newsitem.headline: Presidents of China, South Korea have good talks.

text.p: The presidents of China and South Korea discussed bilateral issues, economic relations and trade at a meeting on Sunday, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesman Shen Guofang said.
He said the atmosphere during the talks between China's Jiang Zemin and South Korea's Kim Young-sam on the fringes of the annual APEC meeting here had been "very good".
"President Kim indicated his hope to conduct contacts with the Northern part (North Korea) and said he would like to see stability maintained in the Korean peninsula," Shen said.
He did not specify China's response.

But asked whether China supported proposed four-way talks between the two Koreas, the United States and China to bring a formal peace to the peninsula divided by the last Cold War frontier, Shen said Beijing's consistent policy was to support stability there.
"As for four-party talks, because there are differences of opinion between the parties concerned, we still need further discussions and consultations," he said.
